content: Individuals with preexisting diabetes who are planning to become pregnant should ideally receive thorough preconception care from a multidisciplinary team. This team should include specialists in endocrinology, maternal-fetal medicine, nutrition, and diabetes education. It is essential to establish A1C and glycemic control goals well in advance of conception. Preconception care should comprehensively address glycemic targets, nutritional needs, physical activity, and lifestyle factors. Additionally, it should include screening for and managing any complications related to diabetes. Effective contraception should be utilized until the individual is fully prepared to conceive. For individuals with type 1 or type 2 diabetes who are planning a pregnancy, an eye examination should be performed either before conception or during the first trimester of pregnancy. Follow-up eye exams should be conducted as necessary, depending on the severity of diabetic retinopathy.
